sources.promptSummary: Three expressions without detached brows: surprised wide eyes/upward small pupils/open round beak; focused lowered lids/larger pupils/closed beak; sleepy half lids/down-left pupils/pale blush. Original Kun ink and shading preserved.

Purple and gold diffuse backlight disks, separately exported with maximum alpha0.45, behind the body. No typography or foreground marks.
Four existing themed backgrounds: calmer sunset bay and forest clearing, brighter quiet slate-blue wall/night sea in study and star deck. Outer edge atmosphere retained.
Same message-bottle silhouette with pale cyan illuminated glass, self-luminous paper and two short neck rays, true alpha.
Six miniature scene variants with broad quiet central color fields and reduced edge-only theme hints, matching the six existing backgrounds.
Refine sunset/cafe miniature backgrounds: quiet broad central color fields, scene identity retained only along edges; no high-frequency markings behind the face.
